title: Insider Purchases Far Below the 52-Week High: Decomposing the Disclosure Reaction in Microcap Equities
abstract: arXiv:2602.06198v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Purchases reported under transaction code P on SEC Form 4 by insiders of U.S. equities with an estimated filing-date capitalization of USD 30 million to USD 500 million (13,534 lines, 1,192 issuers, 2018-2024) are followed by a first-day abnormal return that rises steeply with the stock's distance below its 52-week high: 4.13% in the quintile farthest below the high against 0.86% nearest it (two-way clustered t = 9.77); random non-event days of the same issuers show 0.14%. Five tests with decision rules fixed in advance characterize the gradient. Most of it is scale: the beaten-down stocks are 3.10 times as volatile, and with a full set of controls the raw gap fails its pre-specified bar (0.94 points, t = 2.11). Per unit of the stock's own volatility the reaction is 2.51 times as large far below the high (t = 7.49), 1.28 to 3.50 on other estimators, though a variance-weighted slope shows none. The gradient is larger than for insider

translated_title: 远低于52周高点的内部人买入：微型股中信息披露反应的分解
translated_abstract: 对美国市值估计在3000万至5亿美元之间的股票（13,534条记录，1,192家发行人，2018-2024年），内部人在SEC Form 4表格中以交易代码P申报的买入交易，其后首日异常收益率随股价低于52周高点的距离急剧上升：距高点最远的五分位为4.13%，而距高点最近的仅为0.86%（双向聚类 t = 9.77）；同一发行人在随机非事件日的收益仅为0.14%。论文用五项事先固定决策规则的检验来刻画这一梯度特征。其中大部分源于规模效应：超跌股票的波动率高出3.10倍，且在加入完整控制变量后，原始差距未能通过预设的显著性标准（0.94个百分点，t = 2.11）。若以股票自身波动率为单位衡量，远低于高点时的市场反应是2.51倍（t = 7.49），在其他估计量下为1.28至3.50倍，但方差加权斜率则显示不存在此效应。该梯度大于内部人……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现美国微型股中内部人买入后首日异常收益率随股价低于52周高点的距离急剧上升，但通过事先设定的五项检验证明，这一梯度在控制波动率后大部分归因于超跌股票更高的波动率规模效应，而非独立的距离效应。
en_tdlr: Insider purchases in U.S. microcap equities show first-day abnormal returns rising steeply with the stock's distance below its 52-week high, but pre-specified tests reveal that most of this gradient reflects a volatility scale effect of beaten-down stocks rather than an independent distance-based disclosure reaction.
